displayName: Build a content calendar from your top-performing posts
summary: Build next month's content plan from what's already working.

useCases.title: Build a content calendar from your top-performing posts
useCases.message: Help me plan my content for the next month. You might want to start by going through my recent LinkedIn and X posts to see what's performed best. Then identify gaps and draft a content calendar that builds on what's working.
